{{Top|ca|notoc=1}} {{CelestialBody |image= |name=Gangi Moon |region=*[[Outer Rim Territories]]{{GalaxyMapAppendix}} — Based on corresponding data for the [[Morlani system|Ferrix system]], which contains the Gangi Moon per {{EmailCite|email=File:AtlasEmail-2025-07-08.png|creator=[[Jason Fry]]|date=2025-07-08}} *[[New Territories]]''[[Star Wars: Complete Locations, New Edition]]'' places [[Ferrix]], and therefore Gangi Moon per {{EmailCite|email=File:AtlasEmail-2025-07-08.png|creator=[[Jason Fry]]|date=2025-07-08}}, in the area of [[Realspace|space]] ''[[Star Wars: The Galactic Explorer's Guide]]'' identifies as the [[New Territories]]. |sector=*[[Xappyh sector]] **[[Free Trade sector]] |system=[[Morlani system]]''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' |coordinates=[[Standard Galactic Grid|Q-3]] |xyz= |distance= |suns= |orbited= |position= |moons= |routes= |lengthday= |lengthyear= |class= |diameter= |atmosphere= |climate= |gravity= |terrain= |water= |interest= |flora= |fauna= |otherlife= |species= |otherspecies= |socialgroup= |language= |government= |population= |demonym= |cities= |imports= |exports= |affiliation= }} {{Quote|Can they make it to Gangi Moon?''"
"''If they ever make it out of here.|Cassian Andor and the Ferrixian sentry [[Pegla]]|{{Andor|Rix Road (episode)}}}} '''Gangi Moon''' was a [[moon]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories]] and the [[New Territories]]. The moon was situated in the [[Morlani system]] of the [[Free Trade sector]] subsector of the [[Xappyh sector]], which was in grid square Q-3 of the [[Standard Galactic Grid]]. It was close enough to the [[planet]]{{Andor|Nobody's Listening!}} [[Ferrix]] that it was reachable by a [[Breon HOY-39 Dayvan|Breon Dayvan]] [[starship]] with a full [[fuel]] tank. In [[5 BBY]],{{AndorDate|112}} in the aftermath of the [[Ferrix Riot|Rix Road riot]], which protested the [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] control of the planet, the Ferrixian [[Jezzi]] [[pilot]]ed a Breon Dayvan carrying fellow Ferrixians [[Brasso]], [[Bix Caleen]], and [[Wilmon Paak]], as well as the [[Salvage assist unit|droid]] [[B2EMO]], toward Gangi Moon. The group had participated in the riot and hoped that flying to Gangi Moon would let them escape the Imperial [[Ferrix garrison|authorities]]. The fugitive Ferrixian [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor's]] instructions on how to get there included flying over [[Farside Sea]]. ==Behind the scenes== Gangi Moon was first mentioned in "[[Rix Road (episode)|Rix Road]]," the twelfth episode in the [[Andor Season 1|first season]] of the [[Disney+]] television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', which aired on [[November 23]], [[2022]].{{Twitter|starwars|status/1557442379975573504|[[Star Wars]]|date=2022-8-10|quote=This is what revolution looks like. Watch #Andor, a Star Wars Original Series, streaming only on @DisneyPlus September 21.|archivedate=20220810191942}} The moon was misspelled as "Ganji Moon" in "[[Most Wanted: Cassian Andor and Associates]]," an article written by [[Christopher Cooper]] and published in the [[Star Wars Insider 231|231st issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine{{InsiderCite|231|Most Wanted: Cassian Andor and Associates}} on [[April 29]], [[2025]].{{TitanComics|url=m/179-star-wars-insider-231|text=Star Wars Insider #231}} Author [[Jason Fry]] confirmed via email that the Gangi Moon was situated in the Ferrix system,{{EmailCite|email=File:AtlasEmail-2025-07-08.png|creator=[[Jason Fry]]|date=2025-07-08}} also known as the Morlani system. ==Appearances== {{Indexpage}} *{{Andor|Rix Road (episode)}} {{1stm}} ==Sources== *{{InsiderCite|231|Most Wanted: Cassian Andor and Associates}} {{ID|Ganji Moon}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ja=ガンジ・ムーン |ka=განგის მთვარე |pl=Księżyc Ganga }} [[Category:Morlani system locations]] [[Category:Moons in the New Territories]] [[Category:Moons in the Outer Rim Territories]]
